responsibility: Declares the allocator and slot abstractions used to store GCC vrange objects efficiently outside their transient working form. It defines vrange_allocator plus obstack and GGC implementations, vrange_storage as the generic slot manager, irange_storage_slot and frange_storage_slot layouts for serialized integer and floating ranges, and clone/allocation helpers used by long-lived range maps and caches.
same_name_distinction: Defines the storage slot layouts, allocator classes, and public APIs that value-range-storage.cc implements. Unlike the .cc file’s serialization routines, this header is the structural interface used by clients that need to allocate or hold long-lived vrange storage.
